preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= n <= 100 for n in [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, len(lines), 4)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of elements n is between 3 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= 100 for x in seq) for seq in [a, b, c])
preconditions.description: All elements in sequences a, b, and c are integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] != b[i] and a[i] != c[i] and b[i] != c[i] for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: For every index i, the three values a[i], b[i], and c[i] are pairwise distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(p) == n and all(p[i] in {a[i], b[i], c[i]} for i in range(n)) for p, n, a, b, c in zip(parsed_outputs, parsed_ns, parsed_as, parsed_bs, parsed_cs))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output sequence p has length n, and every element p[i] is chosen from the set {a[i], b[i], c[i]}.

postconditions.expression: all(p[i] != p[(i + 1) % n] for i in range(n)) for p, n in zip(parsed_outputs, parsed_ns)
postconditions.description: For each test case, no two adjacent elements in the sequence p are equal, including the wrap-around pair (p[n-1], p[0]).
